review_rules: Songs of the Return and other heroic traditions remain literary/historical testimony, not automatically literal event transcripts
Do not flatten Atmoran, early Nordic, Dragon Cult and later Nordic religion into one static belief system
Night of Tears causes and Eye of Magnus-related interpretations remain source-specific where disputed
Dragon Cult chronology must distinguish Atmoran origins, Skyrim rule, Dragon War and later surviving cult sites
Thu'um feats should distinguish direct observations, saga claims and gameplay mechanics
Cross-link existing Ysgramor, Atmora, Saarthal, Snow Elves, Dragon Cult, Dragon War, Greybeards, Jurgen, Paarthurnax, Miraak, Forelhost and Skuldafn records
